info.name: Workday Security Workday Audit and Compliance Account Signons Security Audit API
Workday Security List security permission changes

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

params.name: fromDateTime
params.description: Start of the date range for filtering permission changes

params.name: toDateTime
params.description: End of the date range for filtering permission changes

params.name: changeType
params.description: Filter by the type of permission change

items.docs: Retrieve a collection of security permission change records, including modifications to security group memberships, domain security policy changes, and access level modifications. Used for monitoring and auditing changes to the security posture of the tenant.
